messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

function.name: get_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
**Short answer:**  
Tesla has **not yet launched the Model S (or any other vehicle) in India**, so there is no official Indian price to quote.

---

### Why there’s no official price

| Reason | Details |
|--------|---------|
| **No local launch** | Tesla’s India launch was announced in 2022 but has been delayed repeatedly. As of now, the company has not opened a showroom, service center, or sales office in India. |
| **Website & pricing** | Tesla’s global website lists prices only for the United States, Canada, Europe, Australia, and a few other markets. India is not among them. |
| **Import‑only market** | Until a local launch, any Model S sold in India would have to be imported. Importers set their own prices, which vary widely depending on shipping, customs duties, VAT, GST, and dealer mark‑ups. |

---

### What you can expect if you import a Model S

| Cost component | Typical range (₹) | Notes |
|----------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Base price (USD)** | $90,000–$100,000 | Current U.S. MSRP for a standard Model S. |
| **Exchange rate** | ₹82–₹85 per $1 | Roughly 2024 mid‑year rates. |
| **Base cost in INR** | ₹7.4–₹8.5 cr | USD price × exchange rate. |
| **Import duty** | 10–20 % | Depends on the exact tariff classification. |
| **GST** | 18 % | Applied on the sum of the base cost + import duty. |
| **Other fees** | 0.5–1 % | Customs clearance, handling, insurance, etc. |
| **Dealer markup** | 5–15 % | Varies by importer. |
| **Estimated total** | ₹9–₹12 cr | Rough ballpark for a fully imported Model S. |

> **Bottom line:** Even if you find an importer, the price will likely be **₹9–12 crore** (≈$1.1–1.5 million), far above the U.S. MSRP because of high import duties and taxes.

---

### How to stay updated

| Action | Why it matters |
|--------|----------------|
| **Follow Tesla’s India launch news** | Official launch dates, pricing, and availability will be announced on Tesla’s India website and press releases. |
| **Check local automotive forums** | Enthusiasts often share import experiences and price estimates. |
| **Contact authorized importers** | They can give you a detailed quote including all applicable fees. |

---

#### Bottom line recap

- **No official price** – Tesla hasn’t launched in India yet.  
- **If you import** – expect a price in the ₹9–12 crore range due to duties, taxes, and dealer mark‑ups.  
- **Keep an eye out** – Tesla may announce a launch and pricing in the near future, at which point you’ll get a definitive figure.
